name: opencode_delegate
description: Delegate a task to the OpenCode CLI running in a dedicated container. Always provide the worktree_dir (from Hermes EXECUTION_DIR) and a pragmatic session_id (which you should explicitly commit to memory using mnemosyne_remember).

worktree_dir.description: The absolute path to the project directory to isolate operations to (e.g. /opt/data/workspace/my-project).

is_resume.description: Set to true if resuming an existing session ID, false if starting a new one.
